dashboard.label: Tableau de Bord Avancé de Supervision Fortigate
dashboard.description: Ce tableau de bord fournit une analyse avancée des logs Fortigate live afin d’identifier les comportements réseau inhabituels, les volumes de trafic anormaux, les connexions refusées, les ports rares, les sources à forte activité et les patterns pouvant indiquer une activité suspecte.

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | eval sentbyte_num=coalesce(tonumber(sentbyte),0) | eval rcvdbyte_num=coalesce(tonumber(rcvdbyte),0) | eval total_bytes=sentbyte_num+rcvdbyte_num | stats count as evenements dc(srcip) as sources_uniques dc(dstip) as destinations_uniques dc(dstport) as ports_uniques sum(total_bytes) as volume_total_octets | eval volume_total_Go=round(volume_total_octets/1024/1024/1024,2) | table evenements sources_uniques destinations_uniques ports_uniques volume_total_Go

chart.title: Évolution du trafic dans le temps

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-24h | timechart span=1h count as evenements

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-24h | eval sentbyte_num=coalesce(tonumber(sentbyte),0) | eval rcvdbyte_num=coalesce(tonumber(rcvdbyte),0) | eval total_bytes=sentbyte_num+rcvdbyte_num | timechart span=1h sum(total_bytes) as volume_octets | eval volume_Go=round(volume_octets/1024/1024/1024,2) | fields _time volume_Go

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | eval sentbyte_num=coalesce(tonumber(sentbyte),0) | eval rcvdbyte_num=coalesce(tonumber(rcvdbyte),0) | eval total_bytes=sentbyte_num+rcvdbyte_num | stats count as connexions dc(dstip) as destinations_uniques dc(dstport) as ports_uniques sum(total_bytes) as volume_octets by srcip | eval score_activite=round( log(connexions+1)*20 + destinations_uniques*5 + ports_uniques*10, 2 ) | sort - score_activite | head 10 | table srcip score_activite

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | eval signification=case( action="allowed","Trafic autorisé", action="block","Trafic bloqué", action="teardown","Fin de session", 1=1,"Autre" ) | stats count as evenements by signification | sort - evenements

chart.title: Détection de sources qui contactent beaucoup de destinations

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where isnotnull(srcip) AND isnotnull(dstip) | stats count as connexions dc(dstip) as destinations_uniques by srcip | where connexions>=10 | sort - destinations_uniques | head 10 | table srcip destinations_uniques

chart.title: Détection de sources qui contactent beaucoup de ports

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where isnotnull(srcip) AND isnotnull(dstport) | stats count as connexions dc(dstport) as ports_uniques by srcip | where connexions>=10 | sort - ports_uniques | head 10 | table srcip ports_uniques

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where isnotnull(dstport) | stats count as connexions dc(srcip) as sources_uniques dc(dstip) as destinations_uniques values(service) as services by dstport | where connexions>=2 AND connexions<=50 | sort connexions | head 15 | table dstport connexions sources_uniques destinations_uniques services
